capabilities: Mark note lines as card fronts with a customizable tag
Define card backs using section dividers (--- or ***)
Export tagged cards to a .mochi zip file
Include images, videos, sounds, and other Mochi-supported attachments
extras: Exported cards are delivered as a .mochi file (a zip of cards and attachments) that must be imported manually via the Mochi app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn tagged note lines into flashcard decks for Mochi.

relations.evidence: exports markdown notes to Mochi flashcards, which is an awesome flashcard app

summary: Exporter that converts notes with a #card tag into a .mochi zip file for import into the Mochi flashcard app.
